content.title: How To Watch the Los Angeles Dodgers
content.text: How To Watch the Los Angeles Dodgers By Edited By Taylor Kujawa The Dodgers are trying for a historic third straight championship A three-peat is a feat not many sports teams get the opportunity to attempt. So watching the Los Angeles Dodgers try for it in 2026 is going to be something to behold. If you’re in the Dodgers broadcast area, Spectrum SportsNet LA, now available on Fubo for the first time, is your hub for live games. Meanwhile, MLB.TV is a service you’ll need if you’re out of market. Sprinkled throughout the season, you’ll also find national TV matchups across FOX Sports, ESPN, NBC Sports, TNT Sports, and Apple TV. I wrote this guide to help those who bleed Dodger blue watch every game throughout the season. Keep reading to learn how to get your TV setup game-day ready. Spring into baseball with DIRECTV! DIRECTV has the most MLB games, including Spring Training, period.* Not only that, but this season you can catch the World Baseball Classic and tons of college ball streaming on your favorite devices. With so much live action on deck, it's time to get your game together by scouting DIRECTV's packages today. View DIRECTV Plans *Claim based on total games carried on Nat'l and combined local Regional Sports Networks. RSNs avail. with CHOICE package or higher. Avail. of RSNs varies by ZIP code and pkg. Blackouts apply. Where to watch the Dodgers—local TV breakdown Angelenos living in the LA area and the broader Dodgers broadcast market (including Hawaii and parts of Nevada) will need Spectrum SportsNet LA for most games in 2026. Aside from live matchups, the network features content tailored to die-hard Dodgers fans, such as player and coach interviews, highlights, and “Backstage: Dodgers.” Dodgers fans who live outside the area can get MLB.TV or MLB EXTRA INNINGS to watch the team on streaming or cable/satellite providers, respectively. These services are subject to local blackouts. Where to watch the Dodgers—national TV breakdown The Dodgers not only play in one of the largest media markets, but they’re also back-to-back World Series champions gunning for a three-peat. Naturally, there will be plenty of opportunities for a nationwide audience to catch their games. Fans can watch the Dodgers from anywhere in the country on NBC, FOX, FS1, ESPN, TBS, and MLB Network. Games on NBC will also stream on Peacock Premium, and there will also be games exclusive to Peacock and Apple TV throughout the season. Best TV plans for watching the Los Angeles Dodgers No matter where you live, you’ll need multiple services in order to watch every Dodgers game. First and foremost, I recommend getting a live TV plan from a traditional cable or satellite provider or a streaming service like DIRECTV. You’d also benefit from subscriptions to Apple TV and Peacock, as multiple games will stream exclusively on those services for not just the Dodgers, but the whole league. And if you live outside of the Dodgers market, MLB.TV or MLB EXTRA INNINGS are the way to go. DIRECTV offers several RSNs, including Spectrum SportsNet LA (ch. 690). It also has many of the national TV channels that will air Dodgers games in 2026. It’s almost a one-stop shop. Apple TV has exclusive rights to Friday Night Baseball throughout the MLB season. A handful of Dodgers games will end up on the service this year. The Dodgers have several games airing on NBC that will also stream on Peacock Premium this season. This choice is perfect for cord-cutters who may not have a provider that includes NBC. Getting MLB.TV is crucial for Dodgers fans who don’t live in the team’s broadcast area. Without it, you’ll be limited to only national TV broadcasts. Find the best TV providers near you Sometimes, you can bundle multiple viewing options into a single plan through a local provider. Offers and availability may vary by location and are subject to change. *Avail. of RSNs varies by zip code and pkg. Get tickets to see the Dodgers! Buy LA Dodgers tickets through our partner, StubHub—your source for the best deals on Dodgers games and more. How to watch the Los Angeles Dodgers FAQ What channel are the Dodgers on? You can watch the Los Angeles Dodgers mostly on Spectrum SportsNet LA for in-market games. National games will be broadcast on TV channels like FOX, NBC, and ESPN, and streaming services like Apple TV and Peacock Premium. Can I stream Dodgers games without cable? The most affordable way to stream in-market Dodgers games is with SNLA+. It's a standalone streaming subscription that gives you 24/7 live access to Spectrum SportsNet LA. Out-of-market fans can watch most games on MLB.TV, and everyone can stream select national TV games with Apple TV and Peacock. Why are Dodgers games blacked out in my area? MLB rules don't allow games to air live on MLB.TV within a team's local broadcast region. To avoid this, Dodgers fans need access to Spectrum SportsNet LA or SNLA+, the team's regional sports network.
